description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between G. L. L. Peiris and Co-operative Wholesale Establishment
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, arbitration processes, and the application of labor laws and regulations. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structures, or any of the other specialized categories.
